summary: This stylesheet defines styles for a container with a copy button and a raw link. The wrapper arranges its children horizontally with spacing, while the copy button has a bordered outline style that changes appearance when hovered or disabled. The raw link is a smaller text element that changes color on hover.

explanations.2: inline-flex makes the wrapper sit inline with surrounding content while using flexbox layout rules internally.
explanations.11: var(--ifm-color-emphasis-700) pulls a color value from a CSS custom property (variable), which lets you reuse colors defined elsewhere.
explanations.18: The :disabled selector targets the button when it has the disabled attribute, letting you style disabled states differently.
explanations.23: :not(:disabled) means 'apply this hover style only if the button is NOT disabled', so disabled buttons won't change color on hover.
